layout_strategy.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 md:p-6

StaffingGrid.description: The core component. A dense table/grid showing Stations (Cols) vs Categories (Rows).
StaffingGrid.style: border border-border rounded-lg bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-sm overflow-hidden

ShiftCalendar.description: Calendar showing A/B/C shifts with color-coded dots/backgrounds.
ShiftCalendar.style: shadcn calendar customized with day-content modifiers

BattalionSelector.style: Large text, heavy font-weight, highly visible

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure white text on red/green/blue backgrounds is legible. Use darker shades of shift colors for text on light backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings to give that tactical/fire dept look.
Create a 'ShiftContext' to manage global shift state (A/B/C).
The Staffing Grid must be responsive. On mobile, stack stations vertically.
Use the provided logo in the Login screen and Top Navigation.
For the 'Staffing Categories' table, ensure rows like 'Min Staffing' and 'Personnel Assigned' are clearly distinct.
Battalion dropdown is critical context. Changing it should filter the grid.
Dark mode is default. Ensure inputs have high contrast borders.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid dark colors with subtle textures.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
